title: Agreement of g₁μ₁ and g₂μ₂ on C_c^∞(O) extends to C_c(O)
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, all Borel measures μ₁, μ₂ on ℝ^P, all g₁, g₂ : ℝ^P → ℝ with g₁ μ₁-integrable and g₂ μ₂-integrable, and every open O ⊆ ℝ^P: if ∫ φ g₁ dμ₁ = ∫ φ g₂ dμ₂ for every C^∞ function φ : ℝ^P → ℝ (smooth of every finite order; Lean ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)) with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ O, then ∫ φ g₁ dμ₁ = ∫ φ g₂ dμ₂ for every continuous φ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ O.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g₁ g₂ : Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable g₁ μ₁ → Integrable g₂ μ₂ → ∀ O : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen O → (∀ φ : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ O → ∫ x, φ x * g₁ x ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, φ x * g₂ x ∂μ₂) → ∀ φ : Eucl P → ℝ, Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ O → ∫ x, φ x * g₁ x ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, φ x * g₂ x ∂μ₂
